name: gpt-im-cooked
description: Review supplied course content with checkpoint-based learning records, targeted mistake practice, and personalized guides.

defaultPrompt: Get me started with GPT, I'm Cooked and show me how to study efficiently.
Check my practice answers and turn my mistakes into targeted questions.
Use my course outline and past exams to build a practice exam with a separate answer key.
interface.longDescription: Understand supplied course concepts through clear conversation and small worked examples. Save learning evidence at checkpoints, revisit mistakes through targeted variants, and resume with concise study handoffs. Review humanities through claims, evidence, and reasoning. Build personalized HTML mock exams with separate keys and PDF study guides by default; optional interactive pages explore selected concepts.
